evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Sparse readouts outperform native prediction on all six primary binary tasks: Qwen averages $0.740$ versus $0.432$ native macro-F1, while residual reconstruction reaches $0.486$, whereas Gemma improves from $0.532$ to $0.714$.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Robustness controls show that the signal extends beyond English, is not explained solely by accompanying OCR, and depends on paired visual evidence.
